name: sdg04
title: SDG 4: Quality education (SDG Atlas of Bolivia 2026)
description: The SDG 4 (Quality education) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026 (SDSN Bolivia) and the 11 indicators behind it, for Bolivia's 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC), at two points in time: near the 2012 census and near the 2024 census, stored as 2012 and 2024 so that their change can be studied.

sources.title: Andersen, L. E., & Argandoña, F. (2026). Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026: Brechas y tendencias del desarrollo sostenible en las Entidades Territoriales Autónomas, 2012–2024. La Paz: Universidad Privada Boliviana, SDSN Bolivia.

geo:citation: GeoDevelopment Observatory of Bolivia (2026). SDG 4: Quality education, from the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026 (343 municipalities, ~2012 and ~2024). https://github.com/quarcs-lab/geo4bolivia/blob/main/docs/datasets/sdg04.md
geo:notes: Both periods are stored at nominal years: 2012 for the Atlas's initial values (~2012) and 2024 for its final values (~2024). Each indicator's actual reference years differ (e.g. 2008 and 2023 for the health survey, three-year averages for volatile indicators) and are given in its description and in `geo:reference_years`.
Load one variable in both periods, e.g. `geo.load("sdg04", variables="index_sdg4", names=True)`, and its change per unit with `geo.change(df, "index_sdg4")`.

The units are the 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC) of 2025. Four of them were created after the 2012 census (TIOC-Raqaypampa, San Pedro de Macha, TIOC-Jatun Ayllu Yura and TIOC-Territorio Indígena Multiétnico); the Atlas gives them values in both periods.

Aggregating to provinces, departments or Bolivia (`geo.aggregate`, `geo.combine`) averages the municipal values weighted by census population (`weighted_mean:population`; the 2012 census for ~2012 and the 2024 census for ~2024, loaded from the `sdg` dataset through `geo:weights`): e.g. `geo.aggregate(geo.load("sdg04"), to="department", dataset="sdg04")`. These are population-weighted approximations, not the Atlas's own department figures.

fields.name: geo_id
fields.title: Municipality ID
fields.description: GDO-Bolivia municipality geo ID (BO-DD-PP-MM) of the 343-unit municipality map (SDSN Bolivia 2025: municipalities and indigenous autonomies), numbered as in GADM 4.1 plus four units created since; its boundary is in geo/boundaries/. It nests by prefix into the department (BO-DD) and province (BO-DD-PP) IDs; department and province numbers follow GADM order and differ from INE codes.

fields.title: Period
fields.description: Period of the values in the row: 2012 holds the Atlas's initial values (near the 2012 census) and 2024 its final values (near the 2024 census). Each variable's actual reference years are given in its description and in geo:reference_years.

fields.name: mun_id
fields.title: INE municipality code
fields.description: Official municipality code of the National Statistics Institute (INE), DDPPMM (department, province, municipality) stored as an integer without the leading zero (e.g. 20101 = Nuestra Señora de La Paz), as in the Atlas. The Atlas's rows are linked to geo_id through this code.

fields.name: index_sdg4
fields.title: Quality education index (0-100)
fields.description: SDG 4 (Quality education) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026, on a 0-100 scale where 100 means the goal's targets are met and 0 the worst situation. Following the global SDG Index of SDSN, each of its 11 indicators is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between a worst and a best value (given in each indicator's description), with the direction set so that higher is always better and values beyond the bounds capped; the index is the simple mean of the available rescaled indicators. Components: Secondary-school dropout rate, girls (%); Secondary-school dropout rate, boys (%); Pre-school attendance, girls 4-5 (%); Pre-school attendance, boys 4-5 (%); Years of education, women 25-35; Years of education, men 25-35; Higher education, women 19+ (%); Higher education, men 19+ (%); Literacy rate, 15+ (%); Qualified teachers, initial level (%); Qualified teachers, secondary level (%). Initial value (~2012) stored at 2012 and final value (~2024) at 2024; its components refer to different years around each census. Atlas: “Índice ODS4”.
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg4_1_asm
fields.title: Secondary-school dropout rate, girls (%)
fields.description: Annual dropout rate of girls in secondary school (grades 1-6): dropouts divided by enrolment, averaged over the years of the period. Source: the Ministry of Education's Education Statistics and Indicators System (SIE). Initial value average 2012–2014 (stored at 2012) and final value average 2022–2023 (stored at 2024). Missing for 4 of the 343 units in each period. In the SDG 4 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 26 (worst, 0) and 0 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 3 and major challenges from 6 on. Atlas indicator 04_01_02_01_asm, “Tasa de abandono en secundaria, mujeres (%)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).

fields.name: sdg4_2_tam
fields.title: Pre-school attendance, girls 4-5 (%)
fields.description: Percentage of girls aged 4-5 who attend a pre-school or initial-education establishment. Source: INE tabulations of the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 4 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 100 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 90 and major challenges from 70 on. Atlas indicator 04_02_02_03_tam, “Porcentaje de niñas de 4 a 5 años que asisten a algún establecimiento preescolar” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).

fields.title: Qualified teachers, initial level (%)

Atlas indicator 04_10_01_10_pci, “Porcentaje de profesores calificados en el nivel inicial” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
